en: Black‑and‑white image of an ornate Belle Époque pavilion with domed roofs and large arched windows, fronted by a formal garden and a wide entrance stair. Elegant people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and gather on the terrace and under a long covered walkway. Dense foliage and palm plantings frame the foreground, while multi‑storey historic city buildings rise behind the pavilion.
